body:
Part of #36. Plan step **P06**. Final integrated acceptance, not the first time tests are written. Each preceding issue owns its own focused regression checks.

Blocked by: #39, #40, #41, #42. These are completion dependencies; synthetic groundwork exceptions are stated below.

## Outcome

A reproducible acceptance run proves the supported real product-profit population, one-page owner journey, data preservation and Windows behavior. Orchestration records evidence and stops on failed gates; it does not decide financial truth by agent agreement.

## Test matrix

- [ ] Reuse `tests/helpers/live-sql-fixture.ts`, `tools/synthetic-sql.ts`, Vitest and packaged Playwright. Cover insert/correction/deletion/backdating, return dependencies outside the month, source reset including reused IDs/unchanged GUID, incomplete header/line transactions and late commit order. Validate the new mapping's lineage/reset decision rather than assuming the current raw-preview GUID check is sufficient.
- [ ] Cover connection/permission loss, timeout, cancellation, corrupt input and restart during import. The last valid report stays usable offline; expenses, settings, adjustments and accepted reports survive.
- [ ] For each supported fixture and the approved real batch, compare independent expectations with normalized records, product rows, daily/monthly sums, detail, saved report and Excel. Deliberately omitted/doubled/mis-costed records must fail reconciliation.
- [ ] Exercise full, partial, missing-cost, genuine-zero, loss and returns-only cases, unsupported dates/units/currency, stale sessions and rapid month/product selection. Synthetic and real provenance remain visibly distinct.
- [ ] Reopen an accepted report after source corrections and application restart; restore encrypted backup on a clean profile and reproduce its profit, coverage and evidence.
- [ ] Run relevant `test:unit`, `test:integration`, `typecheck`, `lint`, `build`, then `package:win` and `test:desktop` against the actual packaged Windows executable. Record actual command/executable/environment. Mac checks remain development evidence only.
- [ ] Measure representative and full approved population through extraction, import, report creation, product paging, export and recovery. Ordinary dashboard/drill-down responses must meet the foundation's below-two-second target on documented Windows hardware. Establish import/memory/disk budgets before accepting capacity changes; retain explicit supported bounds if full history is not yet proven.
- [ ] Perform the owner-task walkthrough with synthetic review media: identify period and coverage, find a sold product, explain its profit, identify the overall result, trace evidence and export. Test keyboard operation and zoom. No owner contact or installation is authorized by this ticket.
- [ ] Run relevant privacy/IPC/read-only/release-inventory checks; keep private data and credentials out of logs, screenshots and release artifacts.
- [ ] Publish the gate matrix with build/commit, fixture/source identity, expected/actual results, timings, evidence and remaining limits. Obtain an independent review at the exact candidate commit and triage actionable findings before handoff.

## Existing references

[docs/operations/synthetic-sql-environment.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/operations/synthetic-sql-environment.md), [docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-acceptance.md](https://github.com/AlesSystems/esmer-market-analytics/blob/6d717bef53f3a7fcf23bb9845e809ae9c79603a3/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-04-esmer-market-rebuild-acceptance.md), `tests/integration/live-consistency.test.ts`, `live-reconciliation.test.ts`, `live-sql-server.test.ts`, `tests/desktop/full-dataset.test.ts`, `clean-install-restore.test.ts`, `package-lifecycle.test.ts` and the P04 (#41)/P05 (#42) focused checks.

## Exit gate

Acceptance evidence identifies exactly which A01–A07 requirements pass and which remain open. A bounded preview cannot be called full-history acceptance. No production connection, owner deployment, unsupported source meaning or L01 completion is implied. Handoff includes branch, commits, PR, checks, evidence and exact remaining Windows/platform work if blocked.

## Execution and evidence

This is a planning backlog, not an instruction to start implementation. First settle the named decisions in P01 (#38) with the user. For each behavioral change, expose the missing contract with a focused failing test, record the actual failure, make the smallest implementation change, and run the relevant checks. Reuse the existing Vitest, Playwright packaged-desktop and synthetic SQL harness; do not create a new orchestration framework.

Use coherent Conventional Commits (`test:`, `feat:`/`fix:`, then evidence as needed). Record the task/gate, commit/build, opaque fixture/source batch, environment, command/procedure, expected and actual result, evidence location and remaining limits. Synthetic success is not source validation; macOS success is not Windows acceptance. Preserve unrelated work and accepted reports. Source access and production rollout retain their separate authorization boundaries.
title: [P1] Verify the profit workflow in the existing harness and packaged Windows app
